headline: Executive order directs federal action to fight bacteria that no longer respond to antibiotics.
what_it_does: This 2014 order sets federal policy on combating bacteria that have become resistant to antibiotics. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of federal agencies cannot be described in detail here. Based on the title, it focuses on how the federal government responds to antibiotic-resistant infections.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on health and disease
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps against antibiotic-resistant bacteria, though the specific duties are not described in the available material.
